FortiGate Firewall Policy Security Audit
================================================================================

─── Overview ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Total policies: IPv4=3, IPv6=0

─── Policy 1: LAN_to_Internet (IPv4) ──────────────────────────────────────────
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
| Policy ID              | 1                                |
| Name                   | LAN_to_Internet                  |
| Version                | IPv4                             |
| Status                 | enable                           |
| Action                 | accept                           |
| Src Interface          | port1                            |
| Dst Interface          | wan1                             |
| Src Address            | all                              |
| Dst Address            | all                              |
| Service                | ALL                              |
| Schedule               | always                           |
| NAT                    | enable                           |
| Anti-Replay            | enable                           |
| Inspection Mode        | flow                             |
| UTM Status             |                                  |
| IPS Sensor             |                                  |
| AV Profile             |                                  |
| Web Filter             |                                  |
| DNS Filter             |                                  |
| App Control            |                                  |
| SSL/SSH Profile        |                                  |
| DLP Profile            |                                  |
| CASB Profile           |                                  |
| WAF Profile            |                                  |
| Email Filter           |                                  |
| File Filter            |                                  |
| Virtual Patch          |                                  |
| LLM Profile            |                                  |
| SSH Filter             |                                  |
| Log Traffic            | disable                          |
| Log Start              |                                  |
| Log HTTP Txn           |                                  |
| Policy Expiry          |                                  |
| ZTNA Status            |                                  |
| Reputation Min         |                                  |
| Comments               |                                  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
Findings:
  [HIGH] UTM disabled on accept policy — all security profiles bypassed.
  [HIGH] No IPS sensor or virtual-patch profile — exploit traffic uninspected.
  [HIGH] No antivirus profile — malware passes through undetected.
  [HIGH] No SSL/SSH inspection profile — encrypted threats bypass all UTM.
  [MEDIUM] No web filter profile — malicious/uncategorized URLs allowed.
  [MEDIUM] No DNS filter — DNS-based C2, tunnelling, malware domains unblocked.
  [MEDIUM] No application control — risky/shadow-IT apps may run freely.
  [MEDIUM] No DLP profile — data exfiltration risk unaddressed.
  [INFO] No CASB profile — unsanctioned cloud service usage not monitored.
  [INFO] No WAF profile — web application layer attacks not inspected.
  [INFO] No email filter profile — if email flows through this policy, spam/phishing uninspected.
  [INFO] No file-filter profile — dangerous file types (executables, scripts) not blocked by policy.
  [INFO] No virtual-patch profile — newly disclosed CVEs not virtually patched.
  [INFO] No LLM profile (FortiOS 8.0) — AI/LLM traffic not inspected for data leakage.
  [CRITICAL] ANY-ANY-ANY accept policy — maximally permissive; full security review required.
  [MEDIUM] Service is ALL — restrict to required protocols only.
  [INFO] ZTNA not enabled on this policy — consider Zero Trust enforcement.
  [INFO] reputation-minimum not set — FortiGuard IP reputation not enforced.
  [HIGH] Traffic logging disabled — no visibility into flows matched by this policy.
  [INFO] logtraffic-start disabled — session start events not recorded.
  [INFO] log-http-transaction disabled — HTTP request details not captured.
  [INFO] No policy comment — undocumented rules are an audit and compliance risk.
  [MEDIUM] Packet capture enabled — likely a debug artifact; disable in production.

Findings:
  [HIGH] UTM disabled on accept policy — all security profiles bypassed.
  [HIGH] No IPS sensor or virtual-patch profile — exploit traffic uninspected.
  [HIGH] No antivirus profile — malware passes through undetected.
  [HIGH] No SSL/SSH inspection profile — encrypted threats bypass all UTM.
  [MEDIUM] No web filter profile — malicious/uncategorized URLs allowed.
  [MEDIUM] No DNS filter — DNS-based C2, tunnelling, malware domains unblocked.
  [MEDIUM] No application control — risky/shadow-IT apps may run freely.
  [MEDIUM] No DLP profile — data exfiltration risk unaddressed.

  [HIGH] Inbound WAN-to-internal accept policy — verify this is intentional.
  [MEDIUM] Service is ALL — restrict to required protocols only.
  [INFO] ZTNA not enabled on this policy — consider Zero Trust enforcement.
  [INFO] reputation-minimum not set — FortiGuard IP reputation not enforced.
  [INFO] Logging 'utm' only — consider 'all' for full flow visibility.
  [INFO] logtraffic-start disabled — session start events not recorded.
  [INFO] log-http-transaction disabled — HTTP request details not captured.
  [INFO] No policy comment — undocumented rules are an audit and compliance risk.
  [INFO] NAT disabled — verify internal IPs are not exposed.
